ios.desc:
Hermes Paper harness is a client for the open-source Hermes agent running on your own computer or server. Bring your home server, VPS or Mac mini; the app talks to it directly.

  • Chat with live tool progress: see every command your agent runs, how long it took and what it returned.
  • Approve risky commands from your phone, in the chat, from a notification or on the lock screen.
  • Replies keep running on your server when you lock your phone, and pick up where they were when you come back.
  • Manage your server's cron jobs: schedules, pause and resume, run now, and a full run history.
  • Every session in one place: chats from the CLI, Telegram and Discord appear alongside the ones you start here.
  • The Hermes Daily: a front page with server status, upcoming jobs, what needs your attention and your activity.
  • Notes that work with your agent: save any reply, attach notes to a question, and have Hermes summarize or extend them.
  • Share links, PDFs, photos and videos from any app, plus Siri, Shortcuts, widgets and Live Activities.
  • Server keys are stored in the iOS Keychain. Nothing goes through our servers.

Terms of Use: https://legal.linking.studio/terms · Privacy Policy: https://legal.linking.studio/privacy

  Requires a Hermes agent with its API server enabled. Hermes Paper harness is an independent app and is not affiliated with Nous Research.
